title: Картка фізичного носія
fields_and_relations: Написи, provenance, склад, оцінки/докази, from/to custody.
required_interaction: Нова оцінка/переміщення з історією; рух носія не переміщує storage_copy файла.

implementation.view_model: Description, append condition/evidence and custody history, create digitization job
implementation.state_storage: Normalized browser store v9; preserves existing user data. Older unstructured preparations require explicit review.
permissions: media.write / physical.write / intake.send / intake.receive / legacy.write / legacy.review / capture.field, explicit archive grants
implementation.atomicity: Authorize and compare expected revision/package state; mutate clone; validate FK/type/version/hash; commit atomically.
implementation.wf10_handoff: Physical description and condition history link to job preparation; any newer description, condition or custody requires readiness re-evaluation.
